notes: No manual or listing with an 8-channel Pan/PanFine/Tilt/TiltFine/Speed/Shutter/Dimmer/Special chart for a white-LED mini beam was found. Searches covered Amazon manual PDFs, manuals.plus (blocked, HTTP 403), ManualsLib, Open Fixture Library (only RGBW mini beams: lixada/mini-beam-rgbw, stage-right/mini-beam-rgbw, both 11/13ch with R/G/B/W channels -- NOT this fixture), Monoprice Stage Right 612980 (10W RGBW, 11/13ch) and Monoprice 612830 (30W white, 4/12ch with colour+gobo wheels). Every generic 10W 'mini beam' found is RGBW 4-in-1 (9/14ch or 11/13ch) and therefore cannot be an 8ch fixture with a single Dimmer and no colour channels. The closest documented match is the discontinued Epsilon Pro Mini Beam: single 8W cool-white LED, 2 deg optic, 540/270 pan-tilt, 6/8 DMX channels, 150x230x240 mm, 2.5 kg, 27W -- its physical values are recorded here but flagged as guesses because the console name 'LED MINI BEAM WH' ('WH' = white housing or white LED) has not been tied to it, and no Epsilon DMX chart could be retrieved (epsilon-pro.com times out). The 8ch chart above simply mirrors the venue console's channel order (repo DMX truth); the strobe ranges follow the common OEM pattern (0-7 closed, 8-15 open, 16-255 strobe) and the 'Special' channel is assumed to be function/reset -- all _guess. The repo GDTF UKing@ZQ02021_80W_MINI_BEAM (ZQ02021, 80W, 18-prism, colour + gobo wheels) is a different, larger fixture and not an 8ch match either.
